summary: Gather-and-draw 2D overlay labels for vehicles. Gated by byte_7CE254 (feature enabled); when labels are suppressed (this+0x8 toggle) or the session is active, it computes screen-space scaling and view bounds from global timing/scaling values, sweeps the active vehicle array at dword_5EF9A0 (stride 4656) up to dword_7C87A0, keeps vehicles whose projected position passes a ray/sphere intersection test and screen bounds, builds a distance-sorted linked list (MergeSort), and renders up to three text labels (name, position, timing gap) via F_2DTextRenderingWithScissorRectangle. Frees the gathered nodes afterwards. Called by ShortComputation_f070 (0049F070).

Render only when labels are enabled (this+0x8 non-zero) or when SessionStateCheck(dword_7CD25C) reports an active session.

Compute scale factors: v33 from ShortComputation_8490(&flt_5EA4E8) times dword_5D6D64 when positive, else 0.0; screen-space anchor from CollisionPenaltyScaler(&dword_7CD204, 4) times dword_5D6D64; view bounds from dword_5D6D60 and CRTFtol(dword_5D6D64), with a 0.05-fraction inner margin.
Pick the view-distance threshold from session phase: SessionPhaseDecode(&dword_5EA510); phases 5-6 give 350.0, anything else 175.0; extra scale from ShortComputation_c910(&dword_5EA510).

Gather visible vehicles: iterate the active-vehicle array at dword_5EF9A0 (stride 4656 dwords, stopping at dword_7C87A0); for slots whose flag word (v6[1405]) has the render bit set, project the vehicle position from the offset fields (v6-2785/-2784/-2783), test it with RaySphereIntersectionTest against the view anchor and distance, and when it passes the screen bounds and depth > 3.0, allocate a 16-byte record plus a 12-byte list node (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper) and append it to the gather list, counting in v37.
If no vehicle was gathered (v37 == 0), free the (empty) list via LinkedListFree and skip rendering.
Sort the gathered list by distance with MergeSort, then walk to its tail.
Look up the reusable label-surface object via WideStringLinkedListSearch(off_5CCC10); when absent, free the list and return.

Draw up to 3 labels over the sorted nodes: stop when the count or the per-frame time budget (derived from dword_5D6D64) is exhausted; per vehicle, when labels are forced (this+0x8) or TerrainHeightComparison(dword_7CD25C, vehicle+18580, -1.0) passes, compute the label size scale from normalized depth, build the text (name/position/flags via "%d %s (%d)" or plain "%s" depending on dword_7C56A4 == 7 and dword_7D0398, plus a " [%d ms]" timing gap appended when SessionStateCheck and the vehicle's +13000 field equals 2), then F_2DTextRenderingWithScissorRectangle.
Restore the label surface's saved size fields (object+92/+96) and free the gather list, releasing the 16-byte record payloads via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the node flag requests it.
Return the last status byte v1 (0 on the suppressed/empty paths, otherwise the value left by the final free).
